name: Secret Roles
use_when: Use when someone at the table or among the NPCs works against the group in secret, and the script must hold the truth.

traitor_acts: claims to be loyal, calmly and with a good reason
claims to be loyal, calmly and with a good reason
goes along with the group and waits
goes along with the group and waits
casts doubt on someone loyal, with half a fact
sabotages something small where nobody can see
passes word to the enemy through a safe channel
slips: a detail that does not fit (a tell the players can catch)
loyal_acts: does the job well and says so
does the job well and says so
suspects the wrong person, out loud
makes an honest mistake that looks bad
